content: iOS Safari blocks all audio autoplay with sound; audio playback (including precise-timed clips) requires a prior user gesture (tap) to unlock the audio context, after which subsequent programmatic play calls work. Standard mitigation: show a 'tap to start/join' screen on the player's phone that unlocks audio, done once per session. Note: in this app's model, only the HOST plays the clip aloud (players do not need audio playback), so this pitfall mainly affects the host's device/browser, not each player's phone -- still needs a host-side unlock tap before the first round.
